items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-keitora-white
reasons: Old charge 4 cleared: now an axis-aligned east-facing side profile. Wheels share one baseline (rows 37-44), no receding side plane. Built the same way as SAME-CHIPSET jp-truck-kei.
Cab roof is a lit top plane, rows 5-12 (8 rows; anchor has 8). Bed rail rows 13-15, with cargo crates rows 16-22 drawn inside the bed and seen from above (filled top).
Old charge 8c cleared: crisp 1px grid, no partial alpha. Outline is tinted dark (26,18,38)/(55,61,82), same as the anchors. White body uses 4 tones (rows 23-36).

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-red-tractor
reasons: Old charge 1/3 on the hood cleared, but only just: hood top is 3 lit rows (31-33), which is exactly the minimum. Louvre row 34 sits behind the front-edge line. The side face below is rows 37-48.
Old charge 3 on the canopy cleared: it is now a white roof plane seen from above, rows 4-10 (7 rows), with a dark front edge rows 11-13.
East-facing side profile with no receding plane. Exhaust stack has a small oval cap (rows 18-20). Outlines are tinted darks, crisp grid. Reads as a tractor in maps 03 and 04.
fixes: Advisory: the seat block (cols 15-28, rows 22-29) shows only 1 lit top row (24) above a face-on backrest. Add a 2-3 row cushion top at rows 27-29 so it reads as a seat.
Advisory: hood top is at the 3-row minimum. Deepen it to 4 rows (30-34) so it is safe against the anchor's 8-row cab roof.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-bicycle-parked
reasons: Old charge 4 cleared: both wheels sit on one baseline (rows 16-29, rear cols 1-15, front cols 17-31). Plain side profile, no diagonal recession.
Basket (cols 21-31) shows a lit far rim at row 4 and produce inside seen from above at rows 5-8 (4 rows), with a front rim at row 9 and wicker front rows 10-14. Rear carrier has a top at rows 13-15.
Old charge 8d cleared: at 1x in map 01 it reads clearly as a parked mamachari with a front basket. Outline is tinted navy/purple darks.
fixes: Advisory: the saddle (cols 9-15, rows 9-11) is only a 1-row lit top. One more light row would make it read as a seat.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-wooden-pole-transformer
reasons: 6: the pole's top end is not a closed cap plate. The crossarm (rows 4-11) is a straight band that runs off both canvas edges: cols 0 and 15 hold fill tones (L/O browns), not outline, so its ends are cut square by the canvas. Above it, rows 0-3 are a white dome. SAME-CHIPSET jp-pole-wood closes its crossarm into a rounded, outlined plate that is narrower above (rows 10-12) and below (rows 16-18), with a cream top 5-6 rows deep.
Crossarm top-vs-front reads as a light-to-dark gradient (row 6 light, rows 7-9 mid, rows 10-11 dark), not a clearly separated plane, so I can't confirm the view (sure=false).
Old charge 3 cleared: the transformer can now shows a lit elliptical lid, rows 15-19 (5 rows).
Not used in any of the 6 maps. Next to the 48x144 anchor pole used in every map, this 16x48 pole reads as a squat lantern or bin on a post. The 14px-wide can swallows the 6px shaft.
fixes: Close the crossarm inside the canvas, about 1px in from each side: give it outlined, rounded ends and a lit top plane 4+ rows deep (light top rows, then a 2-row dark front), drawn like jp-pole-wood rows 10-18.
Show the shaft continuing above the crossarm to a small elliptical cap plate, with the insulators sitting on the crossarm top.

Hang the transformer can off one side of the shaft (about 8-9px wide), not centred over it, so the pole stays readable. Or match the anchor's pole scale (48px wide, multi-tile) so wires line up with jp-pole-wood.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-well-handpump
reasons: Old charge 2 cleared: lit far rim rows 6-8, dark interior with water rows 9-13 (5 rows, meets the 4-row minimum), front rim rows 13-15. Stone curb front face rows 16-27.

Old charge 3 on the pump head: it now has a 2-row lit cap (rows 7-8) over the green body. The base slab has a lit top rows 24-25 over a front rows 26-28. The diagonal handle (cols 27-31, rows 1-11) is a lever, not a receding face.
Old charge 8d cleared: in map 01 it reads as a round stone well with blue water and a green hand pump. Outlines are tinted darks.
fixes: Advisory: the curb front (rows 16-27) is random speckle. One or two stone-course lines would sharpen it at 1x (not a gate charge).

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-rice-rack-hasagi
reasons: Kind: a hasagi drying rack is an open frame, so closest_kind is frame (minimum top rows 3). Judged as a frame.

Old charge 1 cleared: the top beam shows a dark back edge at row 5, a lit top plane rows 6-8 (visible at cols 0-6 and 41-47 and between sheaves), and a dark front rows 9-11. Back edge to front edge = 5 rows.
Sheaves draped over the beam show rounded lit tops above it (rows 2-5), so the fill reads from above. X-crossed legs, crisp tinted outlines. Legible in maps 03 and 04.
fixes: Advisory: the X-pole tips are cut flat by the top edge (row 0 holds light fill, cols 1-4, 7-10, 20-29, 40-47). The right-hand X pole is also cut by the right edge (col 47, rows 0-31). Pad the canvas or end the poles inside it with outlined tips.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-scarecrow-pair
reasons: Old 'sure=false' on the hats cleared: each sugegasa is now a wide lit brim seen from above (rows 3-7, light crown centre) with a dark underside at rows 7-8.
Mound bases show a top plane from the back edge at row 24 to the front-edge line at row 27 (4 rows). Front/body rows 9-23.

Old charge 8c cleared: clean tinted dark outlines (46,29,28)/(51,26,24). Readable faces (rows 9-11), arm poles (rows 12-13), kimono and post. Reads as two scarecrows at 1x in maps 01-04, on a par with jp-jizo.
fixes: Advisory: the right scarecrow's arm pole is cut at col 31 (row 13 holds fill, not outline). End it 1px inside the canvas.

items.label: jp_inaka_pack/jp-inaka-bamboo-fence-gate
reasons: Old charge 1 cleared: the fence wings now show a lit top cap plane from the back-edge outline at row 9 through rows 10-16 (7 rows, light 7/6/5 tones). Dark under-rail rows 17-18, slats rows 19-29. Depth matches the 6-7 row capped tops of SAME-CHIPSET jp-gate and jp-school-gate.

Gate roof is a tile slope seen from above, ridge rows 0-2 and slope rows 4-11, widening downward (trapezoid, not a rhombus). Eave shadow row 12, lintel with a top at rows 13-16, posts rows 13-29 and an open passage.
Tinted outlines, crisp grid. In map 01 it reads as a bamboo fence with a roofed gate.
fixes: Advisory: the fence wings run off cols 0 and 63 with no end posts. Fine for a tiling segment, but add an end-post variant for free-standing use.

summary: Group C redraws: 7 of 8 pass. Every old charge on keitora, tractor, bicycle, well, hasagi, scarecrow pair and fence gate has been fixed. The hasagi should be relabelled as kind frame. The tractor hood and seat are at the minimum and could use deepening. Remaining fail: wooden-pole-transformer, charge 6 (sure=false). Its crossarm is a square band cut off by both canvas edges under a white dome, not a closed overhanging cap plate like jp-pole-wood's, and the centred transformer swallows the shaft. Advisory: clipped pole tips on the hasagi and a clipped arm on the scarecrow.
